interactables.name: Derek
interactables.text: The Husband, [Derek], lies flat on the bed in brand-new noise-canceling headphones, radiating the deep peace of a man who has finally solved his one problem.

topics.text: He lifts one ear cup with two fingers. 'Something heavy rattled down the hall around [seven]. Wheels. Dinner cart, probably - the maid does her run at seven.' He considers the ceiling. 'Didn't look. Wasn't my problem.' The ear cup goes back down.

topics.prompt: Stare at the headphones until he explains
topics.text: 'What? Everyone copes differently.' He taps the box on the nightstand. 'That bird screamed at five every morning. Viv left me a note - [do something], she said. So I did something. Legal. Non-violent. Three hundred dollars.' He looks briefly, profoundly at peace.

topics.prompt: Knead the duvet beside him, thoughtfully
topics.text: He watches you knead. He does not stop you. 'You know what is funny,' he says slowly, 'now that somebody with whiskers asks. The hall rattled [twice] that night. Once with the soup smell. Once without.' He frowns for the first time all evening. 'Huh.'

interactables.text: A crew manifest on the dresser, entries all evening. One line stands out, dashed off in a hurried scrawl: '[2x equipment cases] - [7:00 PM].' The signature is a scribble with a tail.
A collected dinner tray waits on the dresser: [soup bowls scraped clean], silverware squared away. The dinner cart came through this wing on schedule, then, and somebody ate well.
A handwritten note on the nightstand: 'Derek - Rudebeak woke me up at 5AM. AGAIN. Do [SOMETHING] about that bird or I am calling my [lawyer].' - V.
An open box for top-of-the-line noise-canceling headphones. Purchase receipt inside: [yesterday's date]. Someone finally [snapped].

localDeductionSentence: Derek shrugged off the [Hallway Rumble] as the dinner service - the [Service Tray] says the cart did come - but the manifest also logged [Heavy Cases] at seven.
